profile.heading: Profile
profile.lead: Designer and Frontend Engineer with 6+ years of experience in digital product, UX/UI and frontend development, building on a longer background of 15+ years in graphic design, identity and visual communication. I work at the intersection of design, technology and systems, translating complex problems into product experiences, design systems and coherent, maintainable frontend implementations. I've worked across UX/UI and development, led frontend architecture and component systems for multiple products and, more recently, researched human-AI collaboration and agent-based work.

items.title: Design-to-Code and Human-AI Collaboration · Warp
items.meta: Personal project · 2026 · Angular, Knowledge Architecture, AI Agents
paragraphs: Research into how much of the definition → design/prototyping → frontend implementation flow can be delegated to AI agents, and under what conditions this can be done reliably, traceably and reproducibly. Includes real design-to-code conversion tests on Angular, with agents that had no prior conversation history, to evaluate replicability and context dependency.

I developed a staged methodology based on traceability, ambiguity reduction, cumulative enrichment, versioning and validation gates, with explicit contracts between layers; the tests identified the design-to-code specification contract as the main bottleneck. Splitting research, documentation, testing and development across multiple agents surfaced a second problem: keeping knowledge, decisions and responsibilities coherent across instances with no shared memory.

In response I built Warp, a Git-based knowledge architecture for maintaining persistent responsibilities, interchangeable agents, explicit documentary authority and automatic structural validation, critically contrasted against DDD / Bounded Contexts, Data Mesh, ADR/RFC, IBIS, W3C PROV and Team Topologies.

items.title: Accessible hybrid component library & design system
paragraphs: I led the definition, design and implementation of a design system and a hybrid component library in Angular 18 and Ionic 8, with WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance, for a healthcare application ecosystem.

rows.def: Primary and semantic token structure, accessibility criteria, component patterns and implementation standards for the whole ecosystem.
Validation of design criteria, resolution of product decisions and alignment with healthcare-sector requirements.
Technical documentation, component usage guides and team training to ensure adoption of the DS as a shared standard.
Evolution model: criteria for adding, changing or deprecating components, version control and review process.
